versions.changelog: Improved result interpretation and error handling, added tier-selection heuristics and model-diversity guidance, and tightened public docs and role/review references.
Trimmed runtime SKILL.md, fixed real script entrypoint paths, and corrected the GitHub repo URL in README for cleaner runtime/docs boundaries.

Initial release: 5-provider council with mechanical synthesis, anti-consensus checks, minority reports, monthly retro
